heard.line: And the soldier was killed still waiting for her word
stanza: And out in the distance her order was heard
And the soldier was killed still waiting for her word
And while the queen went on strangling in the solitude she preferred

partner.line: And out in the distance her order was heard

heard.line: And the ones who speak the words
stanza: But the ones who tell the lies
And the ones who load the dice
Always say the toss is fair
And the ones who deal the cards
Are the ones who take the tricks
With their hands over their hearts
While we play the game they fix
And the ones who speak the words
Always say it is the last
And no answer will be heard
To the question no one asks

partner.line: And no answer will be heard
